summary: Verified Reports redesign (selector → table+filters+export) end-to-end. Backend: 30/30 pytest PASS — added 11 new tests for format=json across all 7 reports (deal-blotter, settlement, open-positions, audit-trail, user-activity, volume-summary, client-activity), incl. RBAC 403 for trader on admin-only reports and status-filter persistence. Existing 19 CSV/PDF tests still PASS. Frontend: full Playwright run as admin and trader — login OK, /reports cards (admin=7, trader=5, audit-trail/user-activity hidden for trader), Deal Blotter table loads 59 records via /api/reports/deal-blotter?format=json (200), CSV+PDF export both download successfully (no 401), status filter applied -> 39 records (200), sort header click works, Back button returns to selector, Settlement (50 rows), Volume Summary with group_by toggle daily(22)→monthly(4) all 200, Audit Trail (admin) loads 106 rows, Trader CSV+PDF export 200. The iter_20 401 export bug is FIXED — ReportsPage now uses the shared axios `api` instance for both table fetch and exports.
critical_code_review_comments: ReportsPage.jsx (487 lines) is on the edge of the 700-line guideline but acceptable; the REPORTS config dict + ReportSelector + ReportViewer split is clean.
AbortController is correctly used to cancel in-flight requests on filter change; canceled errors are filtered out before toast — good.
Minor: handleExport falls back to a generic 'Export failed' toast — surfacing the HTTP status from err.response?.status would aid future debugging.
Backend: volume-summary and client-activity duplicate the trader-scoping logic instead of using _get_deals_for_report (already noted in iter_20). Non-blocking.
Backend: in audit-trail/user-activity, date_to filter appends 'T23:59:59' to created_at strings; works because audit_logs.created_at is stored as ISO string but brittle if ever migrated to BSON date.
test_credentials: trader@fxtracker.com/Trader@123 and admin@fxtracker.com/Admin@123 — both used and verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reports feature is fully verified at backend (CSV+PDF+JSON across 7 reports with RBAC) and frontend (selector→viewer flow, table data, sort, filters, exports for both admin and trader). /app/backend/tests/test_reports.py has 30 regression tests; re-run for any future change to /api/reports/*.
